title: A Flow Cytometry Method for Assessing CAR Cell Binding Kinetics Using Stable CAR Jurkat Cells
author: Alex Shepherd
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Prepare complete R10 medium
steps.instruction: Make 500 mL RPMI‑1640; add 50 mL FBS (10 % v/v), 5 mL L‑Glutamate (2 % v/v), and 5 mL Penicillin‑Streptomycin (1 % v/v) to obtain R10 complete growth medium.

steps.title: Verify cell health and viability
steps.instruction: Ensure CAR‑Jurkat and target cells are in log‑phase growth, have ≥80 % viability (check with a viability stain), are not older than three months in culture, and have been tested for mycoplasma. Split cells 1–2 days before the assay; for adherent targets aim for 70–80 % confluency.

steps.title: Resuspend cells at 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL
steps.instruction: Remove cells from the incubator, count them, spin down, and resuspend each cell type separately in R10 complete medium to a concentration of 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL.

steps.title: Optional antibody prestaining
steps.instruction: If cells lack a fluorescent reporter, stain effector or target cells with the appropriate antibody (e.g., CD45, anti‑VHH/scFv, CD19, or in‑house VHH/scFv‑FITC). Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL R10, add antibody, incubate 15 min in the dark at room temperature, then wash with 5 mL 1× PBS, spin 500 × g for 3 min, discard PBS and resuspend in R10 to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL.

steps.title: Add base medium to plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 50 µL R10 complete medium into each well of a 96‑well U‑bottom plate (Falcon catalog 353077).

steps.title: Add CAR‑Jurkat effector cells
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of CAR‑Jurkat suspension (1 × 10⁶ cells/mL) to each well so that each well contains a total of 100 µL (e.g., for a 1:10 ratio add 5 µL effector after adding 45 µL target).

steps.title: Mix and incubate plate
steps.instruction: Gently shake the plate side‑to‑side, then incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 30 min (minimum; assay works 10 min–4 h). For a temperature‑control run, incubate at 4 °C (no doublet formation). If using adherent targets, keep incubation short enough to prevent cell adhesion.

steps.title: Prepare flow cytometer
steps.instruction: Power on the flow cytometer, run Cytometer Setup & Tracking (CS&T), and prime the high‑throughput sampler (HTS).

steps.title: Acquire data
steps.instruction: Run the 96‑well plate on a BD LSRFortessa (or equivalent). Collect 75 µL per well or 50 000 events, mixing at 3 µL/s. Use the following voltage settings: FSC 180 V, SSC 250 V, FITC 480 V, PerCP‑Cy5‑5 730 V, APC 600 V.
